docs.purpose: Returns a trade contractor's personalised, ranked, paginated feed of nearby work opportunities — construction permits, builder profiles and, when enabled, committee-of-adjustment applications — scored on proximity, timing, project value and opportunity, so the contractor can find work worth bidding on near them.
docs.data_story: It reads 12 tables — `permits`, `permit_trades`, `trades`, `cost_estimates`, `neighbourhoods`, `lead_views`, `wsib_registry`, `entities`, `entity_projects`, `coa_applications`, `trade_forecasts` and `user_profiles` and writes nothing. Its response shape is **unmeasured** as a pick-by-name whitelist — it passes rows through, spreads a row into a computed object, or assembles the payload dynamically, so there is no single list naming what leaves the server. It is called from 1 place: `mobile/src/hooks/useLeadFeed.ts`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `QUERY`. It declares its `database.reads[]` with named columns, its response projection as an explicit whitelist, its auth class, its rate bucket and its staleness — and `outputs.writes` is forced to `"none"`. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: The file's SPEC LINK cites docs/specs/03-mobile/71_lead_feed_discovery_interface.md, which does not exist — the real file is the archived path recorded here (verified by find). Thin handler; all logic delegates to getLeadFeed() in src/features/leads/lib/get-lead-feed.ts, which runs one large UNION ALL query (permit + builder candidates, plus a coa arm when the LEAD_FEED_DISABLE_COA killswitch is off) with cursor pagination. user_profiles is read indirectly via getCurrentUserContext, not this file's own SQL. Rate-limited to 30 req/min per user. A PostGIS pre-flight check returns a structured 503 in dev environments missing the extension. Logging is PIPEDA-conscious: lat/lng truncated to ~100m, and the DB-error path omits user_id/lat/lng entirely. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: AUTH CLASS: 'authenticated' (route-guard.ts:124 + :165-167). An authenticated caller with any trade receives, per item: full permit address parts + lat/lng + description, cost_estimates estimated_cost and cost_tier, competition_count, and — for BUILDER items — entities.legal_name, primary_phone, primary_email, website, photo_url and the WSIB business_size (get-lead-feed.ts:367-373, :369). That is contact PII for a business entity, served with no entitlement check (ctx.subscription_status is available at get-user-context.ts:149 and never consulted by this route). Radius is capped at 50 km (distance.ts:12) so the exposure is geographically bounded, but the cursor lets a caller page the whole radius 30 items at a time under a 30 req/min limit. // KILLSWITCH: `LEAD_FEED_DISABLE_COA !== '0'` at route.ts:146 means CoA leads are OFF unless the env var is exactly '0' (default-on fence, documented :131-145) — the 3-arm SQL at get-lead-feed.ts:700-704 is built at module load regardless, and a module-load throw at :709-716 refuses to boot if the injection regex misses. // The route comment at :192-193 claims 'none of the above should throw because every helper is documented as never-throws' — the code DISAGREES: getLeadFeed explicitly rethrows (get-lead-feed.ts:1094, and its own header at :5-8 says so), so the catch at :191 is a live path, not defensive-only.
